overview.value: Subaru learns that objects in this new world are named very similarly to the ones in his own.
Felt teaches Subaru how time works in her world.
Emilia and Puck discuss Reinhard, the Master Swordsman, and his many divine protections.
After being hired at Roswaal’s mansion, Subaru has a chat with the maid sisters Ram and Rem.
Roswaal and Subaru have a chat while sharing the mansion’s luxurious bath.
Emilia continues to insist on doing something to thank Subaru for saving her.
Subaru asks Beatrice about the library she maintains for Roswaal.
Subaru is still embarrassed about resting his head in Emilia’s lap, and the maid sisters aren’t about to let him forget it.
Subaru learns just how kind and considerate Ram can be.
Subaru tells Ram about the promises he made to Rem while they track the mabeasts through the forest.
Subaru and Emilia reunite after the mabeasts are defeated and his curses erased.

Subaru wakes up to find himself in a classroom where Emilia is a teacher. Attempting to ask her about Puck, she tells him that the familiar is the school’s principal. After his questions disrupt class and he is sent to stand in the hall, Subaru vows to return to his own world, before wondering what world that really is.
Subaru meets another teacher at the mysterious school he's awakened in...
Subaru finds himself in a maid café with two very familiar maids serving him.
Visiting a café where Beatrice and Anastasia work, Subaru orders their most popular item, a Meow Meow Omelet. The omelet is delivered by Puck, who then eats it.

At an arcade Subaru meets with Felt who finding her arcade coin while explaining she’s having a game contest with Reinhard. Failing to retrieve her only coin Emilia suggests a game machine to Felt that give coins.
Felt's arcade competition with Reinhard continues, with a little help from an unexpected visitor...
Subaru visits a certain doujinshi expo and finds Rem sitting at a booth, selling a book she wrote.
Subaru continues to explore the doujinshi expo and bumps into two other unexpected attendees, Crusch and Priscilla.
Subaru finds himself on the beach, greeted by the sight of Crusch and Rem in swimsuits. Is this some kind of reward?!
Subaru awakens on the beach again... but this time he's buried in the sand. Who could have done this?!
Subaru visits a convenience store to buy a drink, but its owner is a very shrewd business woman…
Subaru returns to the convenience store…and this time Emilia stands behind the counter! It’s the situation he’s been waiting for!
Subaru visits a bookstore to buy a copy of a favorite book, but the employee at the register doesn’t trust his motives…
Subaru and Emilia wait at the bookstore for the rest of the gang’s arrival to take advantage of an exciting new release!

After being saved from the Witch Cult, he is now working for Subaru. He recalls moments during those events and sees him as an old friend that he had met before. He thought to himself that he may be from Kararagi, but he wasn't sure. Subaru enters the carriage and gave him encouraging banters, which made Otto a little bit embarrassed. He then tells Otto to hurry and meet with Roswaal.
Petra and Otto meet for the first time.

After encountering Garfiel and escorted to the Sanctuary, he finds himself stranded in the middle of nowhere. He suddenly noticed that Garfiel was right next to him. He tells Otto to go to Roswaal, but he was told by Ram to not visit him. He then asks him how did he know Frederica and Garf are related. Otto didn't understand what he meant and he thought that Subaru told him that and he insists that it was due to their sharp teeth, but Garfiel didn't get it. The episode ends with them trying to find the saying is either "The rushing ladybug folds leaves" or "The rushing ladybug blows up".

Petra reflects on her decision to work as a maid in the Mathers' Domain. Despite Frederica's warnings about the challenges and hardships of the job, Petra remains determined and optimistic. Her cheerful attitude and dedication to her duties provide a refreshing contrast to the more serious events unfolding in the main series.

Otto recalls at the time when he before he joined Emilia's camp, he would compare Emilia to the Witch of Envy because she has the same looks as her. But seeing her that she works hard to help others, he reconsiders her as a friend rather than an enemy.
Otto recalls how he was "looked down upon" and "teased" by Subaru and Ram

Otto returns to Garfiel to talk about the deal they had made. He had decided to turn down the offer that Garfiel had made and had sided with Subaru. And with that, he returned the ore to Garfiel and quickly escaped to search for Subaru.

Six days had passed since Petra worked as a maid in the Mathers' Domain. Frederica recalled the time that Petra wanted to apply to work as a maid. She warns her that working as the mansion's maid takes a lot of hardships and dedication and it isn't easy to do. Despite her warnings, Petra is still obligated to work as a maid. And so, Frederica accepts her.

Ricardo writes a report of the mission after the subjugation of the White Whale and the battle of the Witch Cult. Ricardo asks her about her report, but Tivey enters and told him that she didn't and he had to do it for her. Mimi exclaims that she did her report and takes out her book. They read through the report and recalled the time they had rescued Otto. Anastasia entered the room and sees them reminiscing what happened during that mission. Ricardo recalled that she and the Pearlbattons had been tied up before in the past, making Anastasia feel nostalgic about that time. The conversation ends as they all head to the meeting that they appointed for their next job.
Petra recalls the time she first met Frederica.
Erza and Merry discussed how different people react to death, and Erza explained why she didn't like Subaru.
Frandelica records herself teaching Petra to be a maid, and then Petra comes to her house and expresses her desire to sleep with Frandelica.
Otto wants to comfort Natsuki Subaru, and then he falls into the fantasy of his "tsundere" self comforting the "conceited" Subaru.
It's a daily routine in the Sanctuary. Subaru and Ram's bickering, Emilia's helplessness, and Otto's worry and determination.
Ricardo expresses his dissatisfaction with Mimi's inaction, but Mimi and Anastasia remain calm. Yurius asks Anastasia some questions about the merchant.
Otto's diary was obtained by Garfiel, and Garfiel discovered the "suicide note" written by Otto.
Emilia and Echidna were walking in the forest. Echidna pretended to be strong and said that she could keep up with Emilia's pace, but in the end she collapsed on the ground due to exhaustion.
Betty recalls her happy times in the Forbidden Library, especially her conversation with José.
Subaru, Otto, and Garfiel have a post-war discussion.
Roswaal and Elsa make a deal, and then Elsa and Merry talk about Roswaal.
Ram expressed that she didn't care about Otto's existence. In order to change his image in Ram's mind, Otto gave a "speech".
Ram summoned the great elf Puck, and the two discussed Ram's belief - Lord Roswaal.
The witches all praised Emilia's performance in the trial, and then at the tea party, they teased about the relationship between Echidna and Natsuki Subaru.
Merry questions Elsa's remarkable healing ability, and Elsa explains why she possesses it.

Frandelica watched Garfiel and Otto conversing outside the door, and told Petra that she was a little jealous of Otto, who had such a good relationship with Garfiel. Then, in a very cute way, Petra helped the siblings.
Subaru talks about today's events in front of a sleeping Rem. Remembering Emilia and Beatrice's words, Subaru whispers that he wishes Rem was here, and he hears Rem's voice...
Frederica tries to calm Petra down as she explodes with frustration, but then Ram appears before them. Petra, after hearing Frederica and Ram's words, seems to reflect on her behavior, but... ?
Mimi, who has arrived at Roswaal's mansion, is "shocked" to see Garfiel. This... could it be... Garfiel is flustered by the joyful Mimi. This is the story of their precious first encounter.

Subaru and Emilia meet Crusch, a fellow candidate for the throne. Crusch's knight, Ferris, notices that Subaru's gate is broken and becomes enraged. ...However, something seems strange. When he looks to his side, he sees a young girl standing next to Subaru.

Subaru and Beatrice encounter Al outside the Water Hagoromo Pavilion. Subaru is puzzled by Al's behavior of treating him as a "brother" despite being from a different camp. Subaru's perception is different from what he expected, and Al mutters softly, "Do you need a hint...?"

Subaru finds himself in a humorous situation as he attempts to adapt to his new role in the mansion. The episode showcases his interactions with the mansion's staff and his efforts to fit in, all presented in the series' signature chibi art style. While the episode doesn't advance the main plot, it provides fans with a delightful and comedic interlude.

The characters participating in the Royal Selection event gather for a social meet-up filled with lively and humorous interactions. The episode highlights the personalities and quirks of the candidates and their supporters as they engage in playful banter and lighthearted competitions. The tone is comedic and charming, focusing on the bonds and rivalries that develop among the group during this important event.

The candidates for the royal selection and their followers engage in more playful competitions and conversations, each trying to showcase their unique charms and strengths. The episode focuses on character interactions filled with humorous misunderstandings, friendly rivalry, and heartwarming moments that deepen the bonds between the characters.

The spotlight is on Emilia and her party as they face the everyday challenges and comedic mishaps of adventuring together. From misunderstandings to the quirks of each party member, the episode humorously showcases the group’s dynamics and the small struggles they encounter while trying to work as a team.

The characters prepare for a theatrical performance filled with humorous anticipation and behind-the-scenes antics. The episode follows the cast as they rehearse and navigate the comedic challenges that come with putting on a show—miscommunications, forgotten lines, and over-the-top acting all contribute to the fun.

the episode dives into the romantic and sometimes awkward interactions between the characters, presenting a series of short, sweet, and comedic vignettes. Using the chibi art style, the episode highlights moments of affection, misunderstandings, and playful teasing among the main cast.

Petra is asked by Roswaal to search for the chef who has run away. While walking through the garden, she finds a person buried in the shrubbery, and it turns out to be Diaz, the chef she is looking for! It seems that Diaz ran away because he wasn't interested. In response, Petra remembers her conversation with Ram and tries to persuade him that "you can't keep running away."

As Otto heads to Pristella, Petra, Frederica, and Ram, acting as his advisors, emphasize various requests to him. As Otto feels down because he is left to his own devices and no one is concerned about him, Emilia appears before him..
Ram appears before Otto in a sulky mood. It seems that Roswaal is avoiding her... Otto asks if anything has changed recently, and Ram tells Roswaal, "I love you."
Ram appears before Otto in a sulky mood. It seems that Roswaal is avoiding her... Otto asks if anything has changed recently, and Ram tells Roswaal, "I love you."
Petra is shocked when Roswaal reveals his "weakness" to her at a dinner party. Diaz then tries to give her something...
Roswaal returns to the castle with Frederica and Petra after the meeting. Ram, who had been left in charge, rushes to Roswaal's side, seizing the opportunity.
Petra keeps Meili company while she's locked up in the dungeon. Petra makes a request to Meili, who is always saying mean things.
Anastasia has been taken over by an artificial spirit. Beatrice receives a shocking confession from Subaru. Emilia comes to Beatrice, who is observing Anastasia with Subaru...
Emilia and the others are worried about Subaru and Ram, who won't wake up. Then Ram wakes up...
Julius gazes at Joshua, who sleeps in the field hospital in Pristella. Ricardo's "nose" points out a relationship with his brother that he has no memory of, but Julius's mind remains troubled...?
Donna is bewildered by Julius's aggressive advances. To prevent her secret from being revealed, she asks Subaru, with whom she shares the secret, for help.

Julius is giving his all to Anastasia. When Subaru, unable to bear watching any longer, asks him what's wrong, Julius says he doesn't want to let go of what he's gained so far. When Julius asks if he's being greedy, what will Subaru say...?
In a heavy atmosphere, Eri Dona and Julius walk down the corridor of the watchtower. Eri Dona recalls the day she first met Anastasia.
Garfiel comes to Otto, who was injured in the battle for the water gate city. The two, who couldn't accompany Subaru and Emilia, talk about their future.
Felt and Reinhard visit Otto, who is recuperating. A visit from a royal candidate and a sword saint. Otto says he's come a long way from being a merchant, and Felt responds...

Sirius is to be entrusted to the royal capital. Reinhard, who has taken on the role of escorting him, exchanges words with Ricardo and others, as well as Garfiel who has come to see them off, and departs Pristella with Felt.
Meili faints after failing her first job. When she wakes up, Elsa has completed the job in her place. Meili notices something strange about Elsa's actions and sees what happens next.

Felt confronts Sirius, who is being escorted, inside a dragon carriage heading to the royal capital. Felt shows her frustration as Sirius laments his own constitution that brings misfortune and calamity.
Upon arriving at the prison tower, Reinhard takes Sirius away. Felt watches them go, but is suddenly called out to from the side. The person is Russell Fellow of the Royal Capital's Merchants Guild.

Priscilla and her group return to their territory in the southern part of the kingdom. Heinkel, seeking a chance to redeem himself, kneels before Priscilla and bows his head. Priscilla speaks to him as if she can see through him, but...

Priscilla and her group return to their territory in the southern part of the kingdom. Heinkel, seeking a chance to redeem himself, kneels before Priscilla and bows his head. Priscilla speaks to him as if she can see through him, but...

Reid, Shaula, and Alex are out shopping. When they find a bar, Reid starts drinking, completely forgetting about their shopping, which enrages Shaula. Meanwhile, Alex seems to have something on his mind...?

Reid, Shaula, and Alex get separated from their companions in the forest. Leaving Alex, who is disabled, behind, Reid goes ahead. While calming down the angry Shaula, Alex begins to talk about his journey and about Reid.
Shaula continues to wait for her master in the watchtower. For years, decades, centuries, she has gazed out at the desert beyond.
